none: PAS NLM-30E584: Roman Coin: Nummus of Gratian
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin fragment. Nummus of Gratian (367-383), Emperor standing right issue of 367-375, Arles mint issue of 367-375, Reece period 19. About two thirds of flan lost. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Obverse inscription: [--]GRAT[--]. Reverse description; Emperor standing right with vertical spear. Reverse inscription: [GLO]RIA NO[VI SAECVLI]. Diameter (in excess of): 12.8mm, Weight: 0.80gms, die axis: 6
